## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Warn when a provider-specific thinking setting from a broader scope overrides `thinking` by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/10231
* Send the least thinking a model accepts for `thinking=False` on models that can't turn thinking off by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11036
* Raise `NotImplementedError` for a file in a `CohereModel` tool return instead of dropping it by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11114
* Keep concurrent workspace runs attached to their own Prefect environments by @dsfaccini in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11160
* Keep `bool` and `int` inputs on separate `Literal` decision branches in `pydantic_graph` by @dafyy321-pixel in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9091
* Deprecate `google_multi_speaker` on `GoogleRealtimeModel`, which no Gemini Live model supports by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/11064
* Accept async `auth` functions in the hosted MCP capabilities by @mpfaffenb
